questions.stem_text:
Baxter argues that we should view our treatment of the environment as a matter of various
trade-offs whose aim is

options.A: to minimize damage incurred by all individual living beings.
options.B: to promote the functional integrity of ecosystems.
options.C: to minimize the suffering of all sentient creatures.
options.D: to ensure the survival of endangered species.
options.E: to minimize damage to the ozone layer.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - to minimize damage incurred by all individual living beings.

questions.stem_text: Ross claims that the essential defect of utilitarianism is that it ignores

options.C: the role of virtue in morality.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the significance of moral intentions.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not an example Aquinas gives of a self-evident proposition?

options.D: "The sum of the angles of a triangle is 180 degrees."
options.E: "The same thing cannot be affirmed and denied at the same time."

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - "Man is a rational being."
